member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemScalingMode::SHAPE

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemSimulationSpace::LOCAL
member.summary: Simulate in local space.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemSimulationSpace::WORLD
member.summary: Simulate in global world space.

member.name: T:CometEngine::ParticleSystemEmitterVelocityMode
member.summary: Specifies where a particle system reads the velocity of its own emitter from. The Inherit Velocity module and the emission Rate Per Distance both consume that velocity.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemEmitterVelocityMode::TRANSFORM
member.summary: Derive it from how far the emitter transform travelled during the step.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemEmitterVelocityMode::RIGIDBODY
member.summary: Take it from the RigidBody of the emitter entity, or of the closest ancestor that owns one. Falls back to TRANSFORM when the hierarchy has no body.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleSystemEmitterVelocityMode::CUSTOM
member.summary: Use the value written into ParticleSystem::emitterVelocity.

member.name: T:CometEngine::ParticleInheritVelocityMode
member.summary: Specifies how the emitter velocity a particle inherits is sampled.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleInheritVelocityMode::INITIAL
member.summary: Sampled once, on the step the particle was spawned, and kept for its whole life.

member.name: F:CometEngine::ParticleInheritVelocityMode::CURRENT
member.summary: Re-read from the live emitter velocity every step, so slowing the emitter down also slows every particle that is still alive.
